thread:
ops_nina: Noticing a cluster of GPU warmup failures in us-east-1 since the scheduled KMS key rotation + new privatelink NAT rules. warmup_success down to ~48%.

eng_raj: Logs show repeated TCP timeouts to privatelink endpoints and KMS decrypt denies intermittently. sample log: 'dial tcp 10.11.12.34:443: i/o timeout' then 'kms: decrypt AccessDenied' in the same boot sequence.

sre_kim: node join traces confirm kubelet blocked waiting on model blobs. nodes eventually join but after eviction retry -> long cold starts.

ops_nina: hypothesis: rotation created short bursts of keystore traffic while privatelink NAT conntrack pools were reduced by the firewall rollout, causing handshake failures.

security_omar: that firewall rollout reduced ephemeral conntrack entries to limit blast radius. we didn't foresee KMS handshakes coinciding with rotation waves.

eng_raj: immediate mitigation: temporary TF-based exception for svc:gpu-warmup -> privatelink CIDRs for 25m. I'll prepare a tf change with TTL annotation. snippet: ```hcl
resource "fw_rule" "tmp_allow_warmup" {
  name = "tmp-allow-warmup-1744449999"
  src_tag = "svc:gpu-warmup"
  dst_cidrs = ["10.11.12.0/24"]
  ttl_minutes = 25
}
```
Apply in 3m.

security_omar: approve 25m TTL. must add an audit entry referencing rotation ticket and the exception ticket id.

deploybot: canary apply queued to APPLIED: us-east-2 (20 nodes) then us-east-1 if health OK.

billing_lee: cost note - raising conntrack capacity or additional NATs estimated +$3.1k/mo if we keep it long-term. file into infra budget ops.

sre_kim: short-term workaround: enable local artifact cache and retry backoff on warmup. command: `kubectl patch ds gpu-warmup -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"infra/warmup-cache":"true"}}}}}'`. Canary shows success ~95% after patch.

ops_nina: medium-term actions: 1) stagger KMS rotations by region to avoid global handshake storms, 2) increase privatelink conntrack pool and autoscale NATs, 3) add release gating test that simulates keystore rotations + privatelink limits.

security_omar: will update rotation runbook to include region staggering and a pre-check for current privatelink conntrack capacity.

ops_nina: monitoring TODOs: alert if gpu_warmup_success_rate < 0.85 for 10m, add KMS_decrypt_accessdenied > 3/min, and surface privatelink_conntrack_retries metric.

ops_nina: will push the TF exception after canary green, then follow up with incident note and postmortem owner assign. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
